The Linux backend makes external requests and stores keys in the system Secret Service/KWallet. Keys are never saved in chat or JSON. Configure the key on the computer, or transfer it once over HTTPS. Select a paid/cloud model explicitly; automatic titles also use that provider. No automatic local-to-cloud fallback.

Add this external model to the chat selector? Selecting it sends conversation history to the provider and may incur charges on your key. Automatic titles make a small additional request to the same provider.
